name: Fission Uranium Corp.
content: Fission Uranium Corp. is a Canadian-based resource company specializing in the strategic exploration and development of the Patterson Lake South (PLS) uranium property in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin. The company is focused on advancing its high-grade Triple R deposit, which is one of the largest undeveloped uranium deposits in the region. Through disciplined engineering and environmental stewardship, Fission aims to become a leading supplier of uranium to the global nuclear energy market, supporting the transition to low-carbon power generation.

Officers

Ross McElroy(Date: 2013 February)

President

Mr. McElroy is a professional geologist with over 35 years of experience in the mining industry. He has been instrumental in several major uranium discoveries, including the Triple R deposit. He previously held positions with Cameco Corp., Areva, and BHP Billiton.

Aaron Keay(Date: 2023 May)

Chief Operating Officer

Mr. Keay is an experienced entrepreneur and capital markets professional. He has served as a director and officer of several public companies in the resource and technology sectors.

Dwayne Melrose(Date: 2023 January)

Vice President, Exploration

Mr. Melrose has over 30 years of experience in the mining industry, specializing in exploration and project development. He was formerly the President and CEO of LiCo Energy Metals and held senior roles at Cameco.

Directors

William Marsh(Date: 2013 February)

Rob Chang(Date: 2018 April)
